[Fees Structure]
Late Return Fine (Books) = $0.50 per day
Late Return Fine (Laptops/Electronics) = $5.00 per day
Lost Book Replacement = Original cost + $15 processing fee
Printing = $0.10 per B&W page, $0.25 per Color page

[Return Policies]
Standard Books = Must be returned within 21 days.
Reference Books = Cannot be checked out, must be used in the library.
Electronics = Must be returned by closing time on the same day.
Drop Box = Available 24/7 outside the main entrance. Items dropped after midnight are counted as returned the following day.
